about_the_game: This collection contains over 60 characters. Police officers, housewives, students, firefighters, construction workers, farmers, executives, detectives and many more. Give your project a lively touch using this collection.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS Catalina
  • Processor: Intel i3 6300 @ 3.8GHz or AMD FX 8150 @ 3.6GHz with 4 hardware threads
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Catalina
  • Processor: Intel i5 4690K @ 3.5GHz or AMD FX 8350 @ 4.0GHz with 4 hardware threads
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
